anchors.paper_title: ERP CORE: An open resource for human event-related potential research
anchors.reason: ERP CORE has its own sample data (N=40) and supplies the N170 task design this PURSUE dataset reuses. The PURSUE data were collected at 3 other institutions, so this paper does not describe them.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected from participants at three primarily undergraduate academic institutions located in Southern California, Massachusetts, and Virginia during a face perception task conducted in 2017-2018. The task design follows the ERP CORE protocol as described in Kappenman et al. (2021). Detailed methodology and task parameters are provided in the supplementary materials of the ERP CORE publication.
